new_comments.author: phant0um
new_comments.summary:
The 2 new resume tests fail on `main` and pass on this PR's head. Reverting the fix makes them fail again. A separate read of the diff found no blocker.

This is a reproduction and a diff read, not a merge-readiness claim. I did not run `make check-all` or the full suite.

## Environment

- macOS 27.0.1 arm64, Python 3.12.15, pytest 9.1.1, git 2.54.0, uv 0.13.5.
- `uv sync --python 3.12` in a fresh clone, then the tests ran with an empty `HOME` and no credentials in the environment.
- Base `main` at `6b7ae2e`, PR head `c652b20`.

## Reproduction

Three trees: `main` with only the PR's test file copied in (`git checkout  -- tests/test_api_spec_targets.py`), the PR head, and the PR head with `strix/interface/cli_args.py` and `strix/interface/utils.py` reverted to `main`. Each tree ran twice with:

```bash
env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$(mktemp -d)" PYTHONPATH="$PWD" \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_api_spec_targets.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
```

| Tree | Result (both runs) |
|---|---|
| `main` + PR tests | 2 failed, 13 passed |
| PR head | 15 passed |
| PR head, fix reverted | 2 failed, 13 passed (same 2 tests) |

The two failing tests and their messages on `main`:
- `test_resume_restores_staged_api_specs`: `assert [] == [{'source_path': '.../strix_api_specs/openapi_91b3', 'workspace_subdir': 'api-specs', 'protect_metadata': False}]`. On `main`, `local_sources` after resume has no `api-specs` entry.
- `test_resume_rejects_a_missing_staged_api_spec`: `Failed: DID NOT RAISE SystemExit`. On `main`, resuming with the staged spec deleted does not fail.

## Notes from reading the diff

Resume now stages under the same `strix_api_specs/` path and in the same order as the first run. A missing staged file ends in `ResumeError` (exit 2). No blocker. Non-blocking:
- The `api-specs` mount entry returned by `stage_api_specs` sets no `read_only`, so the sandbox may be able to delete the staged files and break a later resume. I did not test this. `read_only: True` could be a follow-up.
- The fix assumes the staging dir under `tempfile.gettempdir()` still exists at resume. If it was cleaned up, or `TMPDIR` differs, resume exits 2. The error message could mention `TMPDIR`.
- `targets_info: Any` in `load_resume_state` hides the type from mypy. A `cast` would be clearer.
- `resumed.targets_info == original.targets_info` in the first test also passes without recomputing `workspace_path`, because `run.json` already stores it. The `local_sources` and bind-mount assertions are what prove the fix.

## Not tested

A real resume against a Docker sandbox: `docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/usestrix/strix-sandbox:1.3.1` returned `manifest unknown`, so the default sandbox image could not be pulled (this matches #1628). Also not run: `make check-all` and the rest of the suite. Separate from this PR, `uv sync` failed on Python 3.15: it tried to build `tiktoken` 0.13 from source and stopped without a Rust toolchain.

new_comments.author: phant0um
new_comments.summary:
4 of the 5 new test cases fail on `main` and all pass on this PR's head. Reverting the fix makes them fail again. A separate read of the diff found no blocker.

This is a reproduction and a diff read, not a merge-readiness claim. I did not run `make check-all` or the full suite.

## Environment

- macOS 27.0.1 arm64, Python 3.12.15, pytest 9.1.1, git 2.54.0, uv 0.13.5.
- `uv sync --python 3.12` in a fresh clone, then the tests ran with an empty `HOME` and no credentials in the environment.
- Base `main` at `6b7ae2e`, PR head `5c57940`.

## Reproduction

Three trees: `main` with only the PR's test file copied in (`git checkout  -- tests/test_cloud_source_upload.py`), the PR head, and the PR head with `strix/interface/cloud/source_upload.py` reverted to `main`. Each tree ran twice with:

```bash
env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$(mktemp -d)" PYTHONPATH="$PWD" \
  .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_cloud_source_upload.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
```

| Tree | Result (both runs) |
|---|---|
| `main` + PR tests | 4 failed, 32 passed |
| PR head | 36 passed |
| PR head, fix reverted | 4 failed, 32 passed (same 4 cases) |

The four failing cases on `main`:
- `test_source_archive_deduplicates_unmerged_git_paths[]` and `[src]`: `At index 1 diff: 'conflict.py' != 'tracked.py'`, with the left list containing 2 more items. `conflict.py` appears once per stage.
- `test_unmerged_git_paths_do_not_inflate_selection_limits[files]`: `CloudError: source contains more than 3 files`.
- `test_unmerged_git_paths_do_not_inflate_selection_limits[bytes]`: `CloudError: selected source is larger than the 250 MB expanded-size limit`.

The fifth new case, `test_unmerged_git_entries_still_count_towards_candidate_limit`, passes on `main` and on the head. It pins the behavior that the candidate limit keeps counting every Git record.

## Notes from reading the diff

The dedupe sits after the candidate counter. `MAX_CANDIDATE_PATHS` still counts every Git record, and `MAX_FILES` and `MAX_TOTAL_BYTES` no longer count a conflicted path three times. No blocker. Non-blocking:
- `seen` can grow to `MAX_CANDIDATE_PATHS` entries. In a small repro, `git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard` listed the stages of one path next to each other, so comparing with the previous record would use constant memory. I did not measure the real cost on a large repo.
- No test covers a modify/delete conflict (file missing on disk) or an add/add conflict (only stages 2 and 3).
- `git ls-files --deduplicate` might be simpler. I believe it needs Git 2.31 or newer and would make the candidate limit count unique paths, but I did not check either.

## Not tested

A real cloud upload, `make check-all`, and the rest of the suite.
